thread:
maria: follow-up from the early-morning latency incident. need owners for postmortem actions and a quick SLO temp change.
kevin: summary?
maria: p95/p99 for /v1/embed spiked; p99 ~900ms from 02:10-02:40 UTC. throughput dropped ~12%. error budget burned ~5.5% for the day. autoscaler lagged, queue backlog peaked at 480.
tarek: saw repeated GPU driver reconnects on pool-a, similar to last month. probable recurrence.
maria: proposed split: dashboard+alerts (owner: kevin, ETA: 24h), autoscale policy + sim-tests (owner: tarek, ETA: 4d), routing rule for huge sequences (owner: maria, ETA: 6d), add golden prompt perf checks (owner: maria, ETA: 7d).
kevin: I'll add panels for p50/p90/p99 by model+route and burn-rate sparkline. also add alert when 10m burn >1.5%. ETA EOD tomorrow.
tarek: autoscaler change: lower scale-up trigger to queue>200 OR avg CPU>60% for 30s; add a 2-min burst pool. will run an isolation load and post results. ETA 3 business days.
ops-bot: PM ticket PM-1403 created and due in 72h.
maria: temporary SLO tweak request: relax p99 from 300ms -> 450ms for 72h for /v1/embed while we validate autoscale. who can approve?
kevin: I can sign off for infra routes we own. will annotate in SLO history and add a note to the dashboard.
tarek: infra will look at driver patching. if unstable we'll shift critical traffic to pool-b.
maria: make sure postmortem has a recurrence tag so this gets prioritized in the monthly SWAT.
kevin: adding promql used in triage:
````
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
````
tarek: I'll attach the load test artifacts to PM-1403 and link PRs when ready.
kevin: dashboard draft PR: https://git.internal/grafana/pulls/1204 (WIP).
maria: schedule a short handoff 09:30 UTC tomorrow to align owners.
kevin: 09:30 works.
ops-bot: Reminder: postmortem due in 72 hours.
maria: thanks all 44d will update PM-1403 after the sync.
